branches.conclusion: Actual complete central doctoral menu lists nine doctorates: Biomedicine, Engineering Sciences, Communication, Law, Philosophy, History, Dental Sciences, Political/Social Studies and Literature. No business doctorate appears. ESE and Economics/Business faculty present in university navigation; no Colombian Management doctorate assigned here.

Actual faculty complete degree menu has one Engineering Sciences doctorate. Its full four named doctoral research lines read: Gestión de Operaciones, Ingeniería de Procesos Ambientales, Ingeniería de la Información y Energía, Sistemas de Ingeniería Civil. One directly named Operations route qualifies; other engineering lines do not qualify from optimization methods alone.
